records.source: Oh, hi.
records.translation: Ah, kumusta.

records.source: Oh, that's right... I heard someone new was moving onto that old farm.#$e#It's kind of a shame, really. I always enjoyed exploring those overgrown fields by myself.$9
records.translation: Ah, tama... Narinig kong may bagong lilipat sa lumang bukid na iyon.#$e#Sayang nga talaga. Lagi akong nasisiyahang mag-isang galugarin ang mga masukal na lupain doon.$9

records.source: Hey, sure. Let's do it. We can be embarrassed together.$h
records.translation: Hoy, sige. Gawin natin. Maaari tayong parehong mapahiya.$h

records.source: Hey, you remembered my birthday... Thanks, @! This is really nice!$h
records.translation: Hoy, naalala mo ang kaarawan ko... Salamat, @! Napakaganda nito!$h

records.source: Hey, you remembered my birthday... Thanks, @!$h#$b#Oh, it's, uh... *sniff*... what is it?$s
records.translation: Hoy, naalala mo ang kaarawan ko... Salamat, @!$h#$b#Ah, ito ay, uh... *singhot*... ano ito?$s

records.source: Wow... the color is so beautiful, like an amethyst. Thanks!
records.translation: Wow... napakaganda ng kulay, parang ametista. Salamat!

records.source: Disgusting... I love it!$h
records.translation: Nakakadiri... Gustung-gusto ko!$h

records.source: Hey, this is my favorite magazine! My Dad won't let me have a subscription, so I have to get it on the black market like this...$h
records.translation: Hoy, ito ang paborito kong magasin! Ayaw akong payagan ni Tatay na magsubskribe, kaya kailangan kong bilhin ito sa lihim na pamilihan nang ganito...$h

records.source: Whoa, that's a creepy looking book... I love it!#$b#*Flip* *flip* *flip*... Ooh... It's full of monsters...$h#$b#I'll have to study this before going into the caves... Thanks!
records.translation: Whoa, nakatatakot ang hitsura ng aklat na iyan... Gustung-gusto ko!#$b#*buklat* *buklat* *buklat*... Ooh... Punô ito ng mga halimaw...$h#$b#Kailangan kong pag-aralan ito bago pumasok sa mga yungib... Salamat!

records.source: Whoa... Where'd you find this? The workmanship is fascinating...#$b#It's a little too rusty to use, but I'll add it to my collection.
records.translation: Whoa... Saan mo ito nakita? Kahanga-hanga ang pagkakagawa...#$b#Medyo masyado itong kalawangin upang gamitin, pero idaragdag ko ito sa koleksiyon ko.

records.source: This makes you wonder... Thousands of years ago, there was probably a little purple-haired cavewoman who played this flute, just like me.#$b#...I'll have to wash it before pressing it to my lips, though.$h
records.translation: Napapaisip ka nito... Libo-libong taon na ang nakalipas, malamang ay may munting babaeng-yungib na kulay-lila ang buhok na tumugtog sa plawtang ito, tulad ko.#$b#...Pero kailangan ko muna itong hugasan bago idampi sa mga labi ko.$h

records.source: $c 0.5#Wow... it's just my color! Thanks, @!$h#Thank you! This is my favorite stone. It's so pretty.
records.translation: $c 0.5#Wow... kulay ko talaga ito! Salamat, @!$h#Salamat! Ito ang paborito kong bato. Napakaganda nito.

records.source: I want to go exploring, but I can tell my Mom is kind of worried. I don't want to add to her stress.
records.translation: Gusto kong maggalugad, pero halatang medyo nag-aalala si Nanay. Ayaw kong dagdagan ang alalahanin niya.

records.source: And just like that, everything's back to normal. It's like magic!$h
records.translation: At sa isang iglap, bumalik sa normal ang lahat. Parang mahika!$h

records.source: Have you seen all the crazy trees around town? Everything looks so different... I feel like we're in a fairy world.
records.translation: Nakita mo na ba ang lahat ng kakaibang puno sa paligid ng bayan? Ibang-iba ang hitsura ng lahat... Pakiramdam ko'y nasa daigdig tayo ng mga engkanto.

records.source: Don't tell anyone, but I snuck into the old community center last night... I think it's haunted!
records.translation: Huwag mong sabihin kaninuman, pero palihim akong pumasok sa lumang Sentro ng Komunidad kagabi... Sa tingin ko'y may multo roon!

records.source: Oh, wow... @! Are you sure you want to give this to me? It's so rare!#$b#I'll admit, my mouth is watering already...$h
records.translation: Ah, wow... @! Sigurado ka bang gusto mong ibigay ito sa akin? Napakapambihira nito!#$b#Aaminin ko, naglalaway na ako...$h

records.source: I heard you've been exploring the old mines. That sounds like fun!$h#$e#...I'm working up the courage to go there myself...$s
records.translation: Narinig kong ginagalugad mo ang mga lumang Minahan. Mukhang masaya iyon!$h#$e#...Iniipon ko ang lakas ng loob upang pumunta roon mag-isa...$s

records.source: Sam and Sebastian asked me to play drums in their band... I've never played drums before, but it's actually pretty fun.#$e#You have to learn how to move your limbs to different rhythms, at the same exact time. I feel like my brain is growing.$h
records.translation: Inanyayahan ako nina Sam at Sebastian na tumugtog ng tambol sa banda nila... Hindi pa ako nakatugtog ng tambol noon, pero masaya pala talaga.#$e#Kailangan mong matutuhang igalaw ang mga braso at binti mo sa magkakaibang ritmo nang sabay na sabay. Pakiramdam ko'y lumalaki ang utak ko.$h

records.source: Hey, I finally beat the first level of Journey Of The Prairie King! Watching you play helped a lot.
records.translation: Hoy, nalampasan ko na sa wakas ang unang antas ng Paglalakbay ng Hari ng Kapatagan! Malaki ang naitulong ng panonood ko sa iyong maglaro.

records.source: Sebastian mentioned that he heard strange music while having dinner the other night...#$e#I didn't tell him it was us! It seemed better to keep it a mystery.$h
records.translation: Nabanggit ni Sebastian na may narinig siyang kakaibang musika habang naghahapunan noong isang gabi...#$e#Hindi ko sinabi sa kaniya na tayo iyon! Parang mas mabuting panatilihin iyong misteryo.$h

records.source: The spirits have a mind of their own...$l
records.translation: May sariling isip ang mga espiritu...$l

records.source: Feeling pretty good about the egg hunt, huh? Well, next year you won't be so lucky...$u
records.translation: Ipinagmamalaki mo ang pagkapanalo sa paghahanap ng itlog, ha? Aba, hindi ka magiging ganoon kasuwerte sa susunod na taon...$u

records.source: I'm still mad that you beat me at the egg hunt last year. You'd better start practicing...
records.translation: Galit pa rin ako dahil tinalo mo ako sa paghahanap ng itlog noong nakaraang taon. Mabuti pang magsimula ka nang magsanay...

records.source: %Abigail is blushing, but she looks happy.
records.translation: %Namumula si Abigail, pero mukha siyang masaya.

records.source: ...You're cute.$l
records.translation: ...Kaibig-ibig ka.$l

records.source: Uh... @? We've been dating for almost a year. Is this going anywhere?$s
records.translation: Uh... @? Halos isang taon na tayong magkasintahan. May patutunguhan ba ito?$s

records.source: I heard you and Sebastian started dating... I didn't realize you guys had a thing...$6
records.translation: Narinig kong naging magkasintahan kayo ni Sebastian... Hindi ko napagtantong may namamagitan sa inyo...$6

records.source: Hey, I heard you and Sam got together... He's a really good guy!$h#$e#We've been friends for a long time. You'd better be good to him, or you'll see my bad side!
records.translation: Hoy, narinig kong naging kayo ni Sam... Talagang mabuti siyang lalaki!$h#$e#Matagal na kaming magkaibigan. Dapat maging mabuti ang pagtrato mo sa kaniya, kung hindi ay makikita mo ang masama kong panig!

records.source: Congratulations on the marriage. I guess this means Sebastian won't be moving to the city like he always talked about.$6#$b#That'll be nice. I'd be kind of sad if I never saw him again. We've always been good friends.$6
records.translation: Binabati kita sa kasal. Siguro ay nangangahulugan itong hindi na lilipat si Sebastian sa lungsod gaya ng lagi niyang sinasabi.$6#$b#Mabuti iyon. Medyo malulungkot ako kung hindi ko na siya makikita. Lagi kaming matalik na magkaibigan.$6

records.source: Haha... I can't believe Sam is a married man, now. Who would've thought?$h#$e#Joking aside, I think he'll make a great father some day.
records.translation: Haha... Hindi ako makapaniwalang may-asawa na si Sam. Sino ang mag-aakala?$h#$e#Bukod sa biro, sa tingin ko'y magiging mahusay siyang ama balang araw.

records.source: Did you hear about the new movie theater in town? I'm excited to check it out!$h
records.translation: Narinig mo ba ang tungkol sa bagong Sinehan sa bayan? Nasasabik akong bisitahin iyon!$h

records.source: I hope a mermaid visits the beach.
records.translation: Sana ay bumisita sa dalampasigan ang isang sirena.

records.source: I'm gonna ask Willy if we can take the scenic route back.
records.translation: Tatanungin ko si Willy kung maaari tayong dumaan sa rutang may magandang tanawin pabalik.

records.source: Maybe we'll see a sea monster on the way back.
records.translation: Baka makakita tayo ng halimaw sa dagat habang pabalik.

records.source: The beach is okay, but it gets boring pretty quick. I'd rather check out that dark jungle, or the volcano!
records.translation: Ayos lang ang dalampasigan, pero mabilis itong maging nakababagot. Mas gusto kong tingnan ang madilim na gubat o ang bulkan!

records.source: Hmm, you think I could sneak my guinea pig onto the island?#$e#Nah, David's probably not much of a swimmer anyways.$h
records.translation: Hmm, sa tingin mo kaya ay maipupuslit ko ang dagang-gini ko sa isla?#$e#Nah, malamang ay hindi rin mahusay lumangoy si David.$h

records.source: My skin gets burnt really easily. So I'm just gonna stay under this umbrella for a while.#$e#I like it in the shade. Too much sun makes me dizzy.
records.translation: Napakadaling masunog ang balat ko. Kaya mananatili muna ako sa ilalim ng payong na ito.#$e#Gusto ko sa lilim. Nahihilo ako sa sobrang sikat ng araw.

records.source: Hey @, want to build a sand castle with me?#$e#Actually, a sand dungeon might be cooler!$h
records.translation: Hoy, @, gusto mo bang gumawa tayo ng kastilyong buhangin?#$e#Sa totoo lang, baka mas astig ang piitang buhangin!$h

records.source: Hey @, you think you could build a raft?#$e#I saw a few cool islands on the way here I want to visit.
records.translation: Hoy, @, sa tingin mo ba ay makagagawa ka ng balsa?#$e#Habang papunta rito ay may nakita akong ilang astig na isla na gusto kong dalawin.

records.source: An island this big has got to be hiding some buried treasure.#$e#Quick, get me a shovel!#$e#Relax, I'm just kidding.$h
records.translation: Tiyak na may nakatagong nakabaong kayamanan ang ganito kalaking isla.#$e#Dali, bigyan mo ako ng pala!#$e#Kumalma ka, nagbibiro lang ako.$h

records.source: Gus made me a dark purple refresher, to match my hair. It tastes great!$h
records.translation: Gumawa si Gus ng madilim na kulay-lilang pampalamig para bumagay sa buhok ko. Napakasarap nito!$h

records.source: Bummer... Willy says we have to stay on the beach...$s#$b#And I brought my sword and everything...$s
records.translation: Sayang... Sinabi ni Willy na kailangan nating manatili sa dalampasigan...$s#$b#At dinala ko pa naman ang espada ko pati kung ano-ano...$s

records.source: B... But... I wanted to dance with...$s#$b#Just kidding! Of course I'm dancing with you. I love you.$h
records.translation: P... Pero... Gusto kong sumayaw kasama si...$s#$b#Nagbibiro lang! Siyempre ay sasayaw ako kasama mo. Mahal kita.$h

records.source: That's flattering... but I'm gonna have to say no. Sorry.
records.translation: Nakatutuwa ang paanyaya... pero kailangan kong tumanggi. Paumanhin.

records.source: What are you doing here? Just leave me alone!$a
records.translation: Ano ang ginagawa mo rito? Pabayaan mo ako!$a

records.source: Don't talk to me!$a
records.translation: Huwag mo akong kausapin!$a

records.source: *sigh*... I can't stay mad at you anymore, @. Let's just move on with our lives.$s
records.translation: *buntong-hininga*... Hindi na ako maaaring manatiling galit sa iyo, @. Magpatuloy na lang tayo sa kani-kaniya nating buhay.$s

records.source: Oh... I... I understand. You see me as just a friend...$s#$b#I guess we weren't really a good match...$s
records.translation: Ah... Nau... Nauunawaan ko. Kaibigan lang ang tingin mo sa akin...$s#$b#Siguro ay hindi talaga tayo bagay...$s

records.source: Oh, hey. Taking a break from work?
records.translation: Ah, hoy. Nagpapahinga ka sa trabaho?

records.source: Oh, hi!#$e#Do you ever hang out at the cemetery? It's a peaceful place to spend some time alone.
records.translation: Ah, kumusta!#$e#Tumatambay ka ba kung minsan sa sementeryo? Payapang lugar iyon upang mapag-isa.

records.source: Ugh... I'm not in a good mood right now.$s#$e#I said I'm not in a good mood... what do you want?$a
records.translation: Ugh... Masama ang timpla ko ngayon.$s#$e#Sinabi kong masama ang timpla ko... ano ang gusto mo?$a

records.source: ...*sigh*...$s#$e#I know my parents mean well, but sometimes they just cannot understand my point of view. Weren't they ever young?
records.translation: ...*buntong-hininga*...$s#$e#Alam kong mabuti ang layunin ng mga magulang ko, pero minsan ay talagang hindi nila maunawaan ang pananaw ko. Hindi ba sila minsang naging bata?

records.source: Hey. Sorry in advance if I say anything rude. I didn't get much sleep last night.#$e#What do you want?
records.translation: Hoy. Paumanhin na agad kung may masabi akong bastos. Hindi ako gaanong nakatulog kagabi.#$e#Ano ang gusto mo?

records.source: #$1 Abigail1#Oh no, I think my Dad's going to cook dinner tonight...$s#$e#I don't feel like doing anything today...$u
records.translation: #$1 Abigail1#Naku, sa tingin ko'y si Tatay ang magluluto ng hapunan ngayong gabi...$s#$e#Ayaw kong gumawa ng kahit ano ngayon...$u

records.source: Wow, I just realized it's Friday. $u#$e#Sometimes I totally lose track of time.
records.translation: Wow, ngayon ko lang napagtantong Biyernes na. $u#$e#Minsan ay lubos kong nalilimutan ang oras.

records.source: We're all going to hang out in the saloon this evening. It's kind of like a Friday tradition, I guess.
records.translation: Tatambay kaming lahat sa saloon ngayong gabi. Parang tradisyon tuwing Biyernes.

records.source: The fresh mountain air is nice on a day like this.$h#$e#I wonder if the frogs will make an appearance soon.
records.translation: Masarap ang sariwang hangin ng bundok sa araw na tulad nito.$h#$e#Iniisip ko kung magpapakita ang mga palaka sa lalong madaling panahon.

records.source: Oh man... I've been pushing off my homework all weekend. Looks like I'll be pulling another all-nighter...$s
records.translation: Naku... Ipinagpapaliban ko ang takdang-aralin ko sa buong katapusan ng linggo. Mukhang magpupuyat na naman ako...$s

records.source: I wonder what would happen if I spent all night in the graveyard?#$q 17/18 Sun_old#@, what do you think happens to us after we die?#$r 17 0 Sun_17#I have no idea.#$r 18 40 Sun_18#We come back as spooky ghosts.#$r 17 0 Sun_17#We go to Heaven.#$r 18 0 Sun_17#Our energy bodies enter the astral plane.#$r 17 30 Sun_nothing#Nothing. We just cease to exist.
records.translation: Ano kaya ang mangyayari kung magdamag akong manatili sa libingan?#$q 17/18 Sun_old#@, ano sa tingin mo ang nangyayari sa atin pagkamatay natin?#$r 17 0 Sun_17#Hindi ko alam.#$r 18 40 Sun_18#Bumabalik tayo bilang nakatatakot na mga multo.#$r 17 0 Sun_17#Pumupunta tayo sa Langit.#$r 18 0 Sun_17#Pumapasok sa astral na daigdig ang mga katawang-enerhiya natin.#$r 17 30 Sun_nothing#Wala. Tumitigil lang tayong umiral.

records.source: $p 17#I guess you think nothing would happen, right?$u|Maybe a wicked ghost would appear!
records.translation: $p 17#Siguro ay wala kang inaasahang mangyayari, tama?$u|Baka lumitaw ang isang masamang multo!

records.source: Hmm, interesting...
records.translation: Hmm, kawili-wili...

records.source: Well that's an interesting theory!$h
records.translation: Aba, kawili-wiling teorya iyan!$h

records.source: You know, that wouldn't be so bad.$8
records.translation: Alam mo, hindi naman iyon magiging masama.$8

records.source: Oh, hi @. Taking a break from your work?#$e#Me too. Oh! Nothing physical... just some online classes I'm taking.
records.translation: Ah, kumusta, @. Nagpapahinga ka sa trabaho?#$e#Ako rin. Ah! Hindi pisikal... ilang klase lang sa internet ang kinukuha ko.

records.source: Hi, I'm glad to see you.$h#$e#I want to take my mind off things for a while... how is your day going?
records.translation: Kumusta, natutuwa akong makita ka.$h#$e#Gusto kong ilayo muna ang isip ko sa mga bagay-bagay... kumusta ang araw mo?

records.source: You came all this way to visit me? That's nice.$h#$e#So have you been exploring the mountain caves at all?#$e#Interesting. I'd like to go there myself one of these days.$l
records.translation: Nagpunta ka hanggang dito upang dalawin ako? Napakabait mo.$h#$e#Kung gayon, ginalugad mo na ba ang mga yungib sa bundok?#$e#Kawili-wili. Gusto kong pumunta roon balang araw.$l

records.source: $query PLAYER_NPC_RELATIONSHIP current any married roommate#I remember when you first arrived in town, I was a little sad that those old woods would be turned into farmland. But now I'm really glad you moved here!$h|...Oh, @! Hi.$h#$e#Want to hang out for a while? Here! Let me read your palm. *giggle*$h
records.translation: $query PLAYER_NPC_RELATIONSHIP current any married roommate#Naaalala ko noong una kang dumating sa bayan, medyo nalungkot akong gagawing sakahan ang matandang kagubatang iyon. Pero ngayon ay talagang natutuwa akong lumipat ka rito!$h|...Ah, @! Kumusta.$h#$e#Gusto mo bang tumambay sandali? Heto! Hayaan mong basahin ko ang palad mo. *hagikgik*$h

records.source: Hi.$l#$e#Do you feel like everything seems unreal lately?$l#$b#Not in a bad way, though.$h
records.translation: Kumusta.$l#$e#Pakiramdam mo ba ay parang hindi totoo ang lahat nitong huli?$l#$b#Pero hindi naman sa masamang paraan.$h

records.source: The birds were happily chirping today. They're too simple to understand the future.#$e#It's better to be like them, isn't it?
records.translation: Masayang humuhuni ang mga ibon ngayon. Masyado silang payak para maunawaan ang hinaharap.#$e#Mas mabuting maging katulad nila, hindi ba?

records.source: Great! I'm sure you'll be able to beat this level with ease.$h
records.translation: Mabuti! Sigurado akong madali mong malalampasan ang antas na ito.$h

records.source: Oh? *sigh*... I guess I'll never get past this level, then...$s
records.translation: Ah? *buntong-hininga*... Siguro ay hindi ko kailanman malalampasan ang antas na ito...$s

records.source: See? You understand why I'm out here, then.#$b#I've lived in the valley my whole life, but I've never really done anything memorable. I want to go on an adventure!$8
records.translation: Kita mo? Nauunawaan mo kung bakit ako narito.#$b#Buong buhay akong nanirahan sa lambak, pero wala pa talaga akong nagawang di-malilimutan. Gusto kong makipagsapalaran!$8

records.source: Sure. I don't want to kill anything, either. I just want to do a little exploring without risking my neck!#$b#I've lived in the valley my whole life, but I've never really done anything memorable. I want to go on an adventure!$8
records.translation: Sige. Ayaw ko ring pumatay ng kahit ano. Gusto ko lang maggalugad nang kaunti nang hindi inilalagay sa panganib ang buhay ko!#$b#Buong buhay akong nanirahan sa lambak, pero wala pa talaga akong nagawang di-malilimutan. Gusto kong makipagsapalaran!$8

records.source: Oh, it's because I'm a girl... isn't it? Ugh...$u^Why? I'm just as strong as you!$a#$b#I'm not some fragile princess.. I can take care of myself!$a#$b#I've lived in the valley my whole life, but I've never really done anything memorable. I want to go on an adventure!$8
records.translation: Ah, dahil babae ako... hindi ba? Ugh...$u^Bakit? Kasinglakas mo ako!$a#$b#Hindi ako isang marupok na prinsesa.. Kaya kong alagaan ang sarili ko!$a#$b#Buong buhay akong nanirahan sa lambak, pero wala pa talaga akong nagawang di-malilimutan. Gusto kong makipagsapalaran!$8
